⚡️ Pezeshkian: Sustainable Persian Gulf security depends on regional responsibility

📌 Tehran, IRNA – President Masoud Pezeshkian stresses the special importance of the Strait of Hormuz to regional and global security and economy, emphasizing a responsible approach based on preserving stability and the interests of regional countries.

In his message on Wednesday to mark World Maritime Day, Pezeshkian said that sustainable security in the Persian Gulf and its waterways depends on cooperation and responsibility among regional countries.
​
Pezeshkian described the sea for Iran as more than an expanse of water, calling it a divine blessing and part of the country’s history, identity and life, as well as one of its most important resources for the present and future.
​
He said security and development cannot be separated, noting that maritime security, ports and transport routes provide the conditions for trade and economic activity, while economic development strengthens the country’s national capabilities.
​
The president said Iran is seriously pursuing its responsibility to maintain security and stability in regional waterways and ensure the security of maritime shipping and trade, relying on the capabilities and experience of naval forces and all those involved in maritime affairs.
​
He also highlighted the importance of maritime science, technology and environmental protection, saying future maritime development requires universities, research, technology and greater attention to marine ecosystems.
​
Pezeshkian called for broader participation by the private sector, shipping companies, fishing communities, ports, maritime industries, universities and coastal communities, while urging the government to reduce barriers, improve infrastructure and facilitate investment.
